project:
Welcome to WildQuest, a world where nature’s balance has been broken.

Three powerful Nature Crystals that protect all living habitats have been lost. Without them, the Forest, Polar, and Ocean worlds are slowly falling into chaos. As a chosen adventurer, your mission is to travel through these three habitats, complete mini-games, and help restore nature. Walk around to find endangered animals and interact with them to know more information.

At the end of each mini game, answer a short quiz about endangered animals to earn back a Crystal.

Restore all three crystals… and restore habitat back to the world.

Controls: WASD or arrow keys, E to interact

Animals are trapped by the bad hunters. Run to save the animals before the hunters reached the animals. Move up or down to change path. Press left to move backward if need to. Avoid the obstacles. Be quick !
